vulnerabilities.description:
Ferret Scan detected aws resource arn in this file.

**Location:** <golden:cloud_resources_test_context> (line 1)
**Confidence:** HIGH (95.0%)
**Detected by:** cloud_resources validator

**Context:**
```
prod arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/PaymentsAdmin
```

**Remediation:**
Remove the ARN and supply resource identifiers from deployment configuration. They name real infrastructure, which helps an attacker map an environment and target it directly.
vulnerabilities.name: Aws Arn Detected
